author: Ari Koslow
title: Brice Turang (foot) scratched from lineup Saturday
desc: Brice Turang was scratched from the Brewers lineup on Saturday.
impact: Turang's foot flared up after he fouled off a pitch on it on Friday. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Story (hernia) without timetable to return
desc: Trevor Story told reporters he does not hold a timetable to return.
impact: Story added that he feels "close." He began ramping up baseball activities this week.

author: Nate Miller
title: Mike Yastrzemski (elbow) could be back Tuesday
desc: Mike Yastrzemski (elbow) could return from the IL as soon as Tuesday.
impact: Yastrzemski has been on the IL since July 10 due to elbow inflammation, but the veteran outfielder may return to the Braves' lineup when first eligible, according to manager Walt Weiss. Yastrzemski was heating up at the dish when he went down, going 7-for-20 with two homers and two doubles over the previous seven games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jeff Criswell (shoulder) placed on 15-day IL
desc: The Rockies have placed right-hander Jeff Criswell on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.
impact: Criswell missed the 2025 season due to injury and has made just three appearances for the Rockies this season, spending the bulk of the campaign with Triple-A Albuquerque. He has posted a 6.85 ERA across 20 appearances for the Isotopes this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Tomoyuki Sugano (back) activated from IL
desc: Rockies right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano (back) has been activated from the 15-day injured list and will start on Saturday against the Reds.
impact: Sugano missed time with back spasms and a split fingernail recently, but will return and start Saturday's contest against the Reds. The right-hander has posted a 4.80 across 16 starts on the season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Sean Murphy (finger) getting close to rehab assignment
desc: Sean Murphy (finger) could soon begin a minor-league rehab assignment.
impact: It has been basically a lost season to this point for Murphy. He did not make his season debut until May 4, and then went right back on the IL with a finger fracture less than a week later. The veteran backstop has been working his way back ever since, and he's finally nearing a rehab assignment. Murphy could be back with Braves in early August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Martinez (elbow) to throw live BP Saturday
desc: Justin Martinez will throw live batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Martinez was recently cleared to face live hitters as he slowly works his way back.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson (forearm) to start Wednesday
desc: Logan Henderson has been cleared to pitch on Wednesday against the Mets.
impact: Henderson was removed from Friday's start early with forearm cramps. It doesn't appear that it will force him to miss any time.

author: Nate Miller
title: Martin Perez (forearm) could return next week
desc: Martin Perez (forearm) could come off the IL as soon as next week against the Padres.
impact: Perez has been on the shelf since July 5 after taking a comebacker off the forearm. The veteran southpaw had subsequent scans return negative, and he has been gearing up toward a return to the Braves' staff.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) to make rehab start Saturday
desc: Jordan Montgomery will make his next rehab start on Saturday for Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Montgomery threw 52 patches in his last rehab start. This could be his final outing on his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Bradford (elbow) to make rehab start Saturday
desc: Cody Bradford is making his next rehab start on Saturday for Double-A Frisco.
impact: Bradford threw 21 pitches in his last rehab outing. He'll continue to ramp up his pitch count.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Lawlar (hamstring) not cleared to run full speed
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said Jordan Lawlar is not yet cleared to run full speed.
impact: Lawlar is still continuing to ramp up in other areas. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: A.J. Puk (shoulder) to seek second opinion
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said A.J. Puk will seek a second opinion.
impact: It usually isn't a good sign when a player requires a second opinion. There should be an update on Puk later in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryne Nelson (elbow) to begin throwing program soon
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said Ryne Nelson will begin a throwing program in the coming days.
impact: Nelson has been dealing with a partially torn forearm flexor. He is trending in the right direction.
